evidence_class_note: OBSERVED: per-grid vectors come from the live encoder. Margins are DERIVED from them by the cosine statistic stated here.

why_this_control: Same-basis encode/decode cannot discriminate a random codebook from a structured one (R2: random bound states are near-orthogonal and decode fine), so that test measures the channel, not the representation.

HENRIVisionEncoder (receipt encoder).verdict: INCONCLUSIVE - random projection reproduces a comparable margin; the statistic is confounded and cannot attribute the accuracy to wave-manifold structure

O_VSA_IngressTokenizer.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE - random projection reproduces a comparable margin; the statistic is confounded and cannot attribute the accuracy to wave-manifold structure

sealed_arms_control.verdict: The readout-projection hypothesis is FALSIFIED: with the SAME readout and the same candidate set, a random operator scores 0.3000 (chance 0.2500) while the fitted operator scores 0.7833. The readout therefore does not manufacture the discrimination. NOTE what remains open: encoding ALONE, with no operator fit, already reaches 0.7333, so the fitted operator adds only 0.0500. Most of the discrimination is attributable to the ENCODER + candidate construction, not to the learned operator.

limits: Tests a NECESSARY condition of the manifold claim, not accuracy.
Rotation is one structural family; other relations are untested.
Encoder refusals are skipped, so n varies per arm.
No task score is produced by this file.
